relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistic studies confirm selective peripheral NaV1.8 inhibition, minimizing central nervous system effects and abuse potential.

relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Phase 3 trials have demonstrated that suzetrigine provides a statistically significant and clinically meaningful reduction in acute postoperative pain compared to placebo

key_findings: Suzetrigine, a selective peripheral NaV1.8 inhibitor, was FDA approved in 2025 for moderate to severe acute pain.
Phase 3 efficacy was similar to hydrocodone/acetaminophen; chronic pain trials (diabetic neuropathy, lumbosacral radiculopathy) ongoing.
